sites.name: Yaroslavsky passenger terminal and forecourt
sites.basis: The mapped terminal annexes and photographed forecourt meet the passenger floor at a low threshold. Correct coarse surface returns inside the occupied site and the adjoining strip of sidewalk.

sites.name: Yaroslavsky boarding tracks and main platform group
sites.basis: The main mapped terminal track and platform group shares a deck near the headhouse. Keep enough vertical separation for paths and rails and blend back beyond the station edge.

sites.name: Yaroslavsky outer passenger platform
sites.basis: Narrow extension to keep the longest passenger platform and its immediate rail approaches tied to the native surface.

terrainReference.basis: The standard outside forecourt sample [10,69] sets 149.0277894 m model Y=0. A bounded visualization grade aligns the retained headhouse and adjacent boarding site to the published footprints and photographs. The active reference [19.5,59] samples the 150.1077894 m visualization grade 1.08 m above model Y=0.

limits: The forecourt and track terrace are visual fits to existing map geometry, four standard elevation tiles and ordinary station photos. Rail elevations, dwelling gradients, and entrance dimensions are approximate.

The signed model includes the historic headhouse, attached rear concourse, boarding canopy and eight platform islands. The independent Leningradsky and Kazansky terminals and surrounding roads remain separate. Interiors, trains, signs and overhead wiring remain outside the authored scope.
